original_public_source.project: BioMonI / ISLAND-BIODIV woody forest vegetation; Morgado et al. 2025; published GBIF Darwin Core archive
original_public_source.sampling_heterogeneity: Réunion 20 within-plot tree subplots; other islands four or five; tree DBH>=1cm subset; forest-based purposive habitat frame

question: Before any woody taxon identity or status is read, does the original published archive directly encode a complete species-by-plot taxonomic census, native versus introduced establishment classes, unique source plot identifiers, and native/introduced comparability adequate to test between-plot co-occurrence outside MOVECLIM?
metadata_only_permitted: GET exact official zip by fixed URL, cap raw archive bytes to 5MB
SHA-256 full opaque original archive bytes, inspect zip central directory names/byte sizes/CRC only
Open only meta.xml and inspect rowType, declared filenames, field index and DarwinCore URI names, encoding and ignoreHeaderLines
Check presence of required column semantics, never values; do not open any text/csv/tsv data member
Maintain counts of opened Event/Occurrence biological rows as zero
Record provisional metadata sufficiency and physical/sampling mismatch risks; never infer species status categories or positive ecological direction
reference_taxonomy: Species names and island names must be frozen by source labels before response analysis; avoid synonyms/fuzzy matching post-outcome
strong_admission_conditions: At least 30 separately keyed author original plots and 10 independently keyed per island; fail rather than collapse subplots as independent sites
Species-level woody plant occurrence from a defined census, not positive-only opportunistic records
All 3 islands' tree-plot effort denominators and DBH threshold measurable; Reunion different effort requires fixed normalization or held separately

Exact native and introduced classification recorded per species×island in original author data OR independently provenance-fixed verified taxon status source chosen before target values; absent this STOP without biological rows
Do not treat forest-only data as representative of degraded habitat
No use of local-loss taxa as replication absent independently eligible taxon overlap before outcome
stop_conditions: No unique author plot key in Event schema
Row and file layout lacks reproducible Event/Occurrence linkage
No comparable woody census or sampling opportunity
Any file exceeds 5MB, XML exceeds 256kB or archive metadata invalid
possible_future_comparisons: Within island: plot native vs introduced *woody* richness association conditional on sampling protocol and forest setting; separate island slopes then assess compatibility
Within Terceira: predeclared S1 historical-loss taxa membership only if independently sufficient eligible focal taxa and native/alien status; else not scored
Compare across islands as descriptive transfer, not three independent macroeco forests
cannot_prove: Pico historical source population survived before local losses
Alien plant suppression caused native loss
